decisions.reason: This piqué upholstery fabric sits squarely in the firm's established upholstery and interior-textile knowledge base and its dedicated page suggests enough strategic importance to keep learning and improving it.

The semi-transparent bouclé-effect decorative fabric is closely related to the firm's design-led decorative range, but as a more style-sensitive variant with lower website prominence it carries a moderate rather than low withdrawal risk.
A flame-retardant jacquard curtain fabric strongly matches the firm's functional contract-textile capabilities and customer base, so absorptive capacity is high and continuation is likely.

The double-face wool-blend decoration fabric fits the firm's decorative-textile expertise, yet its more niche material and construction profile makes it somewhat more exposed to portfolio pruning if early demand is limited.

This semi-transparent wool bouclé leno fabric is still adjacent to the firm's curtain and decorative know-how, but its specialist structure and likely narrower appeal make it the most vulnerable of the range while still more likely to be retained than dropped.
